solution:
import time
def timer(fn):
    def wrapper(*a,**kw):
        t=time.time()
        r=fn(*a,**kw)
        print(f'{fn.__name__}耗时:{time.time()-t:.4f}s')
        return r
    return wrapper
@timer
def slow():time.sleep(0.1);return 'done'
print(slow())
